privacyDescription: How Basmet Dawah collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
termsDescription: The terms and conditions governing your use of Basmet Dawah.

privacy.introText: Basmet Dawah ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our platform at basmetdawah.org.
privacy.collectIntro: We collect information that you provide directly to us:
privacy.collectItem1: Account information: your name, email address, and password, or your Google account details if you sign in with Google.
privacy.collectItem2: Account preferences: your preferred language and account type (new Muslim or mentor).
privacy.collectItem3: Learning data: your progress through paths and lessons, your knowledge check results, and the lessons you have saved.
privacy.collectItem4: Starting point answers: your answers to the starting point questions. If you are signed in, these are stored with your account. If you are not signed in, they are stored in your browser.
privacy.collectItem5: Communications: messages you send through the contact form or the Talk to a mentor feature.
privacy.useIntro: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.useItem1: Provide, maintain, and improve the platform and your learning experience.
privacy.useItem2: Track your progress through paths, lessons, and knowledge checks.
privacy.useItem3: Recommend a stage and a path based on your starting point answers.
privacy.useItem4: Match you with a mentor if you request one.
privacy.useItem5: Send you important updates about your account or changes to our services.
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your name and email with your assigned mentor if you request one. We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the platform. This data is anonymized and aggregated.
privacy.cookiesText: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences. If you are not signed in, we also use your browser's local storage to save your starting point answers so you do not have to repeat them. We use Google Analytics cookies to understand usage patterns. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect your ability to use certain features.
privacy.securityText: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information, including encrypting passwords and using secure HTTPS connections. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.childrenText: Basmet Dawah is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.
privacy.rightsItem1: Access, update, or delete your personal information through your account settings.
privacy.rightsItem2: Request a copy of the data we hold about you.
privacy.rightsItem3: Delete your account by contacting us at the email below.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at admin@basmetdawah.org.

terms.acceptanceText: By accessing or using Basmet Dawah ("the platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the platform.
terms.descriptionText: Basmet Dawah is a free educational platform for new Muslims. The platform offers a starting point check, guided paths made up of steps and lessons, knowledge checks, a library of subjects to browse, and an optional Talk to a mentor feature that connects you with a volunteer mentor. Your starting point answers are stored in your browser if you are not signed in, or with your account if you are signed in.
terms.accountsIntro: When you create an account, you agree to:
terms.accountsItem2: Keep your password secure and not share your account with others.
terms.accountsItem3: Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
terms.conductItem1: Use the platform for any unlawful purpose or in violation of these terms.
terms.conductItem2: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the platform.
terms.conductItem3: Interfere with or disrupt the platform or its servers.
terms.conductItem4: Use the Talk to a mentor feature to harass, spam, or engage in inappropriate behavior.
terms.contentText: The lessons, knowledge checks, and other content on Basmet Dawah are provided for educational purposes. While we strive for accuracy and rely on knowledgeable contributors, the content should not be considered a substitute for guidance from qualified Islamic scholars. We encourage you to verify important religious matters with trusted local scholars.
terms.ipText: All content, design, and materials on Basmet Dawah are owned by us or our content contributors and are protected by copyright law. You may access and use the content for personal, non-commercial educational purposes. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from our content without written permission.
terms.mentorshipText: The Talk to a mentor feature connects new Muslims with volunteer mentors. We facilitate the connection but are not responsible for the advice or guidance provided by individual mentors. Mentors are volunteers, and their views do not necessarily represent those of Basmet Dawah.
terms.disclaimerText: The platform is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, either express or implied. We do not guarantee that the platform will be uninterrupted, error free, or free of harmful components.
terms.limitationText: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Basmet Dawah shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of, or inability to use, the platform.
terms.terminationText: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms or engage in behavior that is harmful to other users or the platform. You may also delete your account at any time by contacting us.
terms.changesText: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.contactText: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at admin@basmetdawah.org.
